notes.title: v1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed

 Fixed abnormal operation in Apple Silicon
 Fixed the issue where quests occurred at the same time
 Fixed an issue where the player could not move intermittently when moving the stage
 Fixed a problem that certain messages were not displayed

notes.title: v1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Updated

 When connecting to the controller, it is automatically connected without pressing the button.


Fixed

 When the controller is reconnected, it is connected again to the previously connected player.
 If 4 players participated in the game, a bug that did not proceed with a specific quest was fixed.

notes.title: Official release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281028/c9e6ec12aba7d07092db26f8e4bd7f4361a81570.png

Finally, Too Many Zombies! has been released.
Thank you to everyone who has been waiting so far.

notes.title: v0.9.0 Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! It's Derin.

[Too Many Zombies!] updated to v0.9.0.
Thanks to your play and feedback, I was able to make improvements.
Preparations for release are still in progress. So, I have prepared a demo update to show you the progress.

Always appreciate your support. And I will do my best until release.

Added

New Upgrades - drum magazine, laser pointer
Shows the player connection status on the lobby screen
If the slot is full, you can change the blueprint


Changed

High-grade items are easier to come by
The character's dash knocks back enemies
The consumption materials of the item have been changed - trap, turret
The range of melee weapons has been increased
In multiplayer, the player can move out of the camera area


Fixed

Fixed bug with shadows disappearing from the edge of the screen
Fixed bug where option settings were not applied
Fixed bug where birds to activate mines
Fixed bug where the game would not start on second play
Fixed bug where the mouse could move off the screen

notes.title: v0.8.5 Demo Update & Release Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Sorry to inform you that the release will be delayed by about a month.

I'm currently awaiting the results of the game rating.
It's my fault for being inexperienced in scheduling.
I will release it as soon as the game rating is complete.

In the meantime, I have been working on adding [Endless Mode] and new items.
It will be included at release.
Also updated the demo, so you can check the current working status.

Once again, I apologize for the delay in release.

Thank you for your support.
